nodes.label: Cross-Domain Scientific Workflow Benchmark (300 tasks)
nodes.rationale: 300 end-to-end scientific workflows spanning 6 domains (quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, electrochemistry); 97 released, 203 held-out.

nodes.label: Pass Rate (Full-Completion Criterion)
nodes.rationale: Primary metric: fraction of tasks satisfying complete task contract (score ≥ 99.9); strict criterion reflects that partial progress does not constitute scientific delivery.

nodes.label: Avg. Score (Partial Progress Measure)
nodes.rationale: Complementary metric measuring partial completion; high Avg. Score does not imply Pass Rate success, revealing gap between progress and delivery.

nodes.label: HDS6 Heavy Duty Solver Assessment
nodes.rationale: Process-level assessment of 6 capabilities: Coherence, Evidence, Alternatives, Scope, Tools, Repair; correlates strongly with outcome metrics (r=0.828 with Pass Rate).

nodes.label: Partial Progress to Delivery Gap
nodes.rationale: Central finding: best configurations achieved 20.6% Pass Rate despite 87.9 Avg. Score; gap especially pronounced in analytical chemistry (87.6 score, 4% pass) and electrochemistry (94.9 score, 0% pass).

nodes.label: Failure Mode Analysis (Contract Breaches)
nodes.rationale: 75.5% of non-passing Claude Code runs ended with completion language; tool errors present in 80.7% of non-passing and 94.2% of passing runs; neither indicator reliably predicts success.

nodes.label: Domain-Specific Performance Profiles
nodes.rationale: Quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics showed highest Pass Rates (60% and 38%); materials characterization, analytical chemistry, electrochemistry showed high Avg. Scores but near-zero Pass Rates.

nodes.label: Twelve Frontier Models Evaluated
nodes.rationale: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra, Grok 4.6, Kimi K3, Claude Opus 5, Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro, Apodex 1.1, GLM-5.2, Gemini 3.7 Flash; evaluated with Codex, Claude Code, Frontier Agent scaffolds.

nodes.label: Resource Use and Execution Time
nodes.rationale: Input tokens ranged 2.18–13.73M per task; execution times 21.8–112.8 min mean; Frontier Agent (Agent Team) longest at 112.8 min mean, 272.2 min 90th percentile.

nodes.label: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative AI
nodes.author: Brian Wang et al.
nodes.rationale: Benchmark paper for evaluating AI agents on scientific discovery tasks with realistic workflows and artifact contracts.

nodes.label: Apodex Discovery Benchmark
nodes.author: Brian Wang et al.
nodes.rationale: Benchmark with three illustrative scientific tasks (cell migration, TLC monitoring, reaction calorimetry) requiring reproducible analysis scripts and artifact contracts.

hyperedges.label: Scientific Workflow Evaluation and Completion
hyperedges.rationale: These four concepts together constitute the core contribution of FrontierChallenge: a framework for evaluating whether agents can complete end-to-end scientific workflows, revealing the gap between partial progress and full delivery.
